messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p95 latency spike detected for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 across multiple model variants. Threshold breached for 5m, paging on-call. Rule: inference.p95 > 800ms

oncall-anna: acked — I'm on it. starting triage. mapping who has the hot keys for eu pools.

eng-sre-matt: pulling graphs now. looks like token-per-request increased ~30% at 12:02UTC and concurrent inflight rose 2x. also seeing queue depth climb on gpu-pool-eu-a.

ops-kira: any deploys or autoscaler changes in the last hour? I see a canary rollout for the kv-cache helper ~11:45UTC.

eng-sre-matt: noted. checking rollout timeline vs instance metrics. if kv-cache failed cold-starts could explain p95.

pm-leo: Heads-up: two enterprise customers in eu are on reserved capacity. will need to include them in comms if impact persists.

oncall-anna: quick mitigation plan: 1) scale up eu dedicated pool by +2 nodes (temp) 2) route non-eu traffic to eu-fallback? no, route eu->eu-secondary region (eu-central-1) for non-reserved customers 3) disable kv-cache rollout on eu canary 4) short status page draft. doing 1+3 now.

ops-kira: scaling now — terraform apply for pool replicas in progress. ETA ~3m.

eng-sre-matt: reverting kv-cache canary on eu nodes: kubectl rollout undo deployment/kv-cache-helper -n inference-eu --to-revision=1

eng-sre-matt: also flipping model routing to prefer smaller variant (gpt-small-v2) for best-effort traffic to cut tail latency. patching routing policy.

incident-bot: NOTE: Maintenance runbook triggered by oncall-anna: /runbooks/latency-spike-eu (link)

support-jamie: drafting customer note for reserved customers — rough: "We're seeing elevated inference latency in EU; our engineers have applied mitigations and reserved capacity customers are being prioritized. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause." want to add SLA impact?

pm-leo: include that we have prioritized reserved capacity and are routing failover traffic. say ETA for recovery ~15-30m pending scale-up.

oncall-anna: status page draft (please review) —

Status: Degraded performance (p95 latency)
Components: inference API (eu-west-1)
Start time: 2026-03-15 12:02 UTC
Impact: Increased response times for text generation for a subset of EU customers; reserved capacity customers receiving priority routing; no data loss.
Mitigation: Scaled dedicated pool, reverted recent kv-cache canary, routing adjustments to reduce tail latency.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when new info available

eng-sre-matt: looks good. I'd add "Customers using very long context (>8k tokens) may see timeouts; consider reducing max_tokens in the short term."

support-jamie: customer notification template (short):
Hi {CustomerName},
We're investigating increased inference latency affecting EU region. We've applied mitigations (scaled capacity, reverted recent rollout) and are prioritizing reserved capacity customers. Expected recovery within 15-30 minutes. We'll update you by {ETA}. Apologies for the disruption.

ops-kira: update: scale operation success, new nodes healthy and joined pool at 12:08 UTC. queue depth dropping.

eng-sre-matt: metrics look better — p95 trending down from ~1200ms -> 680ms. still above normal but improving. moving to monitoring.

oncall-anna: updating status page now. posting customer notif for reserved customers only (support+jira blurbs).

support-jamie: sent to affected reserved customers with personalized note + incident reference.

pm-leo: internal comms addendum for execs (one-liner): "Mitigated: EU inference p95 spike caused by a failed kv-cache canary + sudden token-usage increase; capacity scaled and canary rolled back; recovery in progress, customer-impact limited and reserved customers prioritized."

eng-sre-matt: root cause hypothesis: kv-cache helper introduced a regression causing cold cache penalties and increased memory pressure leading to slower kernel launches under higher concurrency. will open a postmortem ticket once stable.

incident-bot: REMINDER: Please add your notes to incident doc: /incidents/1789005432/notes (link)

oncall-anna: handing off to eng-sre-matt for follow-up. I'm out at 12:20UTC for next rotation. Matt — if p95 climbs again, priority is to temporarily route eu->eu-secondary for best-effort traffic and throttle long-context requests at the gateway.

eng-sre-matt: taking over. I'll monitor for 1h and start a deeper investigation.

support-jamie: logging customer cases and scheduling proactive outreach for next 2 hours.

ops-kira: adding runbook note: when kv-cache rollback occurs, warm-up step: run script to pre-populate hot prefixes:
```bash
# warm cache helper prefixes
for prefix in "hello" "support" "search"; do
  curl -s -X POST https://eu-west-1.api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"'$prefix'","max_tokens":16}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $WARM_KEY'
 done
```

pm-leo: thanks all. next update if anything regresses or at close with RCA. :thumbsup:

eng-sre-matt: p95 now ~420ms and stable for 4m. marking as mitigated in timeline. will start RCA ticket and include timing, rollback diff, and customer impact table.

oncall-anna: closing page on my side. leaving notes in incident doc and assigning follow-ups: RCA-1789005432 (eng-sre-matt), customer-comm-1789005432 (support-jamie).

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: p95 latency for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 returned to acceptable range. Root cause: under investigation. Tickets created: RCA-1789005432, FOLLOWUP-1789005432
